# Study Time Statistics 2.6.1

## 中文

- 根据社区反馈，笔记内统计条默认改为不挡写作的简洁单行。
- 新增“简洁单行 / 完整统计 / 不显示”和“顶部 / 底部”选项；设置只影响显示，不删除统计数据，也不改笔记正文。
- 统计条仍随笔记内容滚动；完整模式保留原有指标。

## English

- In response to community feedback, the in-note statistics strip now defaults to a compact line that leaves more room for writing.
- Adds Compact / Full / Hidden and Top / Bottom options. These only change presentation; they do not delete study data or edit note content.
- The strip still scrolls with the note, and Full mode retains the existing metrics.
